objectives.label: Stand the night watch: kill {count} {mob} near {settlement} after dark

title: Work off your name
A night on the walls
summary: You are wanted in {settlement}. {giver} offers a way to make it right: a night's hard watch in place of the fine.
offer: You owe this town, and I would rather have your sword than your coin or your neck. Stand the watch tonight and kill what comes for the walls, and I will speak for you before the court.
progress: The night is long. Keep at it.
complete: You stood the watch. I will speak for you; as far as I am concerned, your name is clean.
